asr.full_text: In the next few minutes you will discover a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create true financial freedom without the need to recruit hundreds of people, and also without regular monthly payments that can drain your bank account and profits. Ok so you may be wondering.. What is digital currency and how can you benefit financially from it? Well digital currency is also known as cryptocurrency and the chances are you have probably heard of Bitcoin. To explain though what digital currency is also known as cryptocurrency, and the chances are you probably heard of Bitcoin. To explaining what the digital currency really is would take too long, and the chances are you wouldn't understand if even I tried. So, to make it as simple as possible to understand? Just think of the evolution of money. Just as we human have evolved over the hundreds and thousands of years. So has our money. For hundreds of years, humans traded goods for pieces of gold, silver, and bronze. Over time, we introduced paper money, then of course came the credit card or debit card, we then saw online payment systems like PayPal being introduced. The next step in this evolution of money is digital or cryptocurrency, the first of which was bitcoin when it first arrived on the scene back in 2009 one bitcoin was valued at just 10 cents as more bitcoins were mined and i will explain what that means shortly the value gradually increased at one time the value of one bitcoin reached over a thousand one hundred dollars those people who bought bitcoins when they were just ten cents made fortunes in fact one man who had bought just $27 worth of bitcoins forgot he had them then found out they were worth eight hundred and eighty-six thousand dollars needless to say he bought himself a new luxury apartment another man bought a pizza with 10,000 bitcoins that pizza today would cost over seven million dollars probably the most expensive pizza in the world now these stories are people getting rich from bitcoin are very common however there were many more stories of people who missed out because they believe some of the uneducated stories written online claiming Bitcoin was a scam well Big Coin was not a scam and today the Bitcoin is worth around $250 and has settled down it's at the standard and prove that digital currency works globally there now hundreds of different digital currencies available it's becoming more and more popular and there are over a hundred thousand businesses across the US alone that accept digital currencies payment for their products Dell computers, Amazon, Expedia, Subway,Apple App Store and Whole Foods just to make a few Bill Gates recently invested 400 million dollars into Digital currency to help pay-the-way for Microsoft also to accept digital currency as payment. Branson has used over 10 million dollars in cryptocurrency. Even Sir Richard Branson recently paid over 600 million dollars in digital currency for his new plane virgin airways. He saved over 15 million dollars in bank charges because he used digital currency. Now do you see why so many large businesses are moving to this new currency? This truth is it is far safer and more secure for people, it is more cost efficient and is not controlled by greedy banks or investment groups. Whether you agree, disagree, like it or don't like it, Digital Currency is here to stay and will soon be the major currency we all use to purchase products. Earlier, I spoke about Mining Digital Currency, so what does that mean, like most people, when you hear the word mining you automatically think of men underground with picks and shovels, right? well it is nothing like that. It is simply a group of computers running 24 hours a day, working on special algorithms. It is the algorithms that are being mined and these are what create digital currencies that become valuable. This is the simplest way to explain mining. So the question we now have is, how can you benefit financially from the new age of digital currency after all the face of buying bitcoins cheap and selling them for huge profits or God right well yes with Bitcoin those days are gone forever it will never reach the dizzy heights of eleven hundred dollars per bitcoi n again however there is a new digital currency now available and it is proven to be even more popular than Bitcoin was. It has many huge advantages over Bitcoin, one of which is that it is backed up with real gold. This makes it much more stable and unlikely to drop quickly and value like Bitcoin did and still can. There is a strong, financially stable company behind this digital currency and it offers a unique business opportunity for ordinary people to help create financial freedom. You see, bit coin is now frowned upon by most people as being out of reach for the ordinary person where as this new currency allows people from all walks of life to tap into the fortunes being made with digital currency. When you become a member of One Coin in purchase your trading package you get access to a comprehensive training program called The One Academy, you will learn exactly how to trade successfully and profit from digital currency. With five education packages available all which contain tokens, which you can then exchange to buy mining slots for producing one coins there are nine different ways to earn money with one coin including startup bonus network bonus, matching bonus and real gold when you personally introduce someone to one coin you'll receive a 10 percent bonus on the business volume associate it to the various packages that are available. OneCoin also uses the very popular Binary system and you will be paid 10 percent of the business volume generated on your weaker leg. Matching bonuses up to 25 percent are also paid down through 4 generations of referrals. Now don't worry if you do not understand what that means as all will be made clear once you become a member. There are also many recognition and other rewards available including an iPhone 6, a macbook air, gold Rolex watches and 500 thousand euros in gold coins. When you join OneCoin, you automatically become a part of the OneLife Club, where you can collect bonus points. As your business grows these can be exchanged for luxury vacations, watches and other incredible rewards. OneCoin has also partnered with the AhramGold coin. This is a hybrid currency and a pioneer in the digital currency world. Each AhramGold coin is backed up with 1 milligram of solid gold, which is kept in a vault in Dubai. So when you join OneCoin you also become an owner of gold.
